minutes.headline: Selectmen held an economic development workshop, agreed to pursue a public survey before forming a committee; no formal votes.
minutes.summary: The meeting was mostly a workshop on economic development. The regional planning commission presented twelve draft recommendations, and residents, the sewer commission and the chamber of commerce weighed in. The board agreed to hold off on an Economic Development Committee, work toward a survey, and move on master plan and open space plan updates. Routine business followed and the meeting adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Select Board held an economic development workshop on 12 December 2017 and took no formal votes.
The regional planning commission presented twelve draft economic development recommendations, and residents, the sewer commission and the chamber of commerce commented.
By consensus, the board chose not to form an Economic Development Committee yet and to collect other towns' committee charges first.
The town manager was asked to develop a public survey on economic development, working with the planning commission, and bring it back to the board.
A member asked for targeted meetings with agriculture and arts groups and the Conservation Commission.

why_it_matters: Any economic development committee, its budget or a town-wide survey mailing would come later and would be paid from the town budget, mostly taxes, so this workshop sets the order of those steps without committing money.
Zoning and permitting changes, such as the village center rezoning discussed, could eventually come to residents as bylaw votes at Town Meeting.
watch_next: The town manager's draft economic development survey, to be brought back to the Select Board.
Whether the board returns to forming an Economic Development Committee after collecting other towns' charges.
